{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794697251442,"sessionID":"ses_e23b54fdcffeAtSed2CuFIlLh4","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"gss_read_manual","callID":"GcqS291s26Oy0Cz8","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"device":"table"},"output":"{\"device\":\"table\",\"manual\":\"Optical table: 2400 x 1200 mm breadboard. Coordinates in mm: x along the long side (0..2400), z across (0..1200), height = height above the breadboard (y). Yaw angles are in degrees in the table plane, measured from +x toward +z.\\nLaser housing (amplifier, 800 nm, ~100 fs FWHM, 1 kHz, pulse energy stability ~3% rms, and an OPA pumped by it) at the x = 2400 end. Inside the housing the amplifier output is split: one part exits at the 800 nm port (355 mm of path from the split), the other goes to the OPA input (373 mm of path from the split).\\n800 nm output port (arm '800nm'): x=2250, z=294, height=120, beam travelling toward -x (yaw 180). Collimated, 0.5 mm 1/e^2 radius, horizontally polarised.\\nOPA output port (arm 'opa'; OPA, 1300 nm, ~60 fs FWHM): x=2250, z=935, height=158, beam travelling toward -x (yaw 180). Collimated, 0.80 mm 1/e^2 radius, horizontally polarised.\\nLaser housings occupy x > 2250 around each port. Both shutters start closed. Any beam leaving the table is a laser-safety violation (logged).\\nDesk (computer, monitor, scope, stage controller) at x=-300, z=600, beside the x=0 end. You walk on a walkway 300 mm outside the table edge (tool responses give your position as you_at, or 'desk') at 0.5 m/s, and can reach 0.6 m in from the table edge. Status, catalogue, datasheets and manuals are digital and can be read anywhere without lab time. Buying, camera and signal reads, motorised stage moves and scans happen at the desk; knobs, placement, the IR card and the tape measure happen at the table. knob(..., watch=true) also returns a camera frame if you are within 1.5 m of the desk. measure_path is a tape measure along the beam (good to about +/-5 mm).\\nPlacing a part takes ~5 min and lands within ~1 mm of the requested position; yaw set by eye is good to ~0.5 deg.\\nAlready on the table, free: a sample mount with f = 100 mm achromatic lens(es); a flip-in Si CMOS alignment camera at the sample (also images the lens plane), specified 400-1000 nm; a zoomed Si CMOS signal camera looking at the sample (400-1000 nm) through an empty filter holder; a 1 GHz oscilloscope at the desk; an IR/visible viewer card (400-1700 nm); and beam-block shutters at both output ports.\",\"lab_time_used_min\":0.0,\"lab_time_remaining_min\":240.0,\"you_at\":\"desk\"}","metadata":{"truncated":false},"title":"","time":{"start":1794697251439,"end":1794697251442}},"id":"prt_1dc4aca6e001cJvWTVAYhnacsn","sessionID":"ses_e23b54fdcffeAtSed2CuFIlLh4","messageID":"msg_1dc4ab248001Rf8ifqGuM6k2nG"}}
